terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Thank you for using ToolHub (toolhub.ai.kr, the "Service"). These terms set out the conditions for using the Service and the rights and obligations of users and the Service.

sections.title: Article 1 (Purpose)
paragraphs: These terms govern the use of every web tool the Service provides, including calculators, developer, media and health tools, and games.

sections.title: Article 2 (Definitions)
items: "Service" means all tools and content provided at toolhub.ai.kr and its pages.
"User" means anyone who uses the Service under these terms. The Service has no membership, so everyone who visits and uses it is a user.

sections.title: Article 3 (Posting and changes)
items: These terms take effect when posted on the Service.
When the terms change, the effective date and reason are posted on this page at least 7 days in advance, or 30 days in advance for changes unfavorable to users.
If you do not agree with the changed terms, you may stop using the Service.

sections.title: Article 4 (Provision of the Service)
items: The Service is free and requires no sign-up.
Features that rely on public data (fuel prices, business registration status, etc.) or outside services may be temporarily unavailable or delayed depending on the provider.
Tools may be added or changed without notice to improve them, and some tools may be discontinued when operationally necessary.

sections.title: Article 5 (Nature of results)
items: Results and guidance from the Service are reference information based on official sources and have no legal effect or official evidentiary value.
Important decisions such as tax filing, payroll, loans, contracts or health matters should be confirmed with the relevant agency or a professional.
There may be a delay between a change in law or rates and its reflection in the Service.
Except in cases of intent or gross negligence, the Service is not liable for damages arising from the use of its results.

sections.title: Article 6 (Game records)
items: When you submit a score to a leaderboard, the nickname you enter (up to 20 characters), score, play time and a random per-device identifier are stored, and the nickname and score are shown to other users.
AI match results (game, difficulty, win/loss) are recorded for statistics.

Online matches record room information (room title, host nickname, game type) on our server, and the game itself runs over a direct browser-to-browser connection (WebRTC). Setting up that connection may reveal your network address (IP) to your opponent's browser.
Inappropriate nicknames or abnormal scores may be removed without notice.

sections.title: Article 7 (User obligations)
items: Disrupt the Service, for example with automated bulk requests that overload the servers
Manipulate scores or submit rankings by abnormal means
Register nicknames or inquiries that defame or offend others
Use the Service for unlawful purposes or use its tools to infringe others' copyright or portrait rights

sections.title: Article 8 (Copyright)
items: Rights to the Service's design, text, guides and source code belong to ToolHub.
Rights to what you create with the tools (converted images, generated text or code, etc.) belong to you; rights to the original material remain with its owner.

sections.title: Article 9 (Advertising)
items: The Service displays Google AdSense ads.
The Service is not responsible for transactions between users and advertisers made through ads.

sections.title: Article 10 (External links)
paragraphs: External sites the Service links to (public agencies, references, etc.) are governed by their own policies.

sections.title: Article 11 (Privacy)
paragraphs: The Service protects user information according to its Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Article 12 (Governing law and jurisdiction)
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea, and disputes arising from use of the Service are settled by the court with jurisdiction under the Civil Procedure Act.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about these terms can be sent via the contact page or to toolhub.ai.kr@gmail.com.
